title: pgbackrest: 2.55.1 -> 2.56.0
reason: Real new 'commands' option-set added: a per-pgbackrest-CLI-command mkOption block generated via `lib.genAttrs [list of ~19 literal command names] (command: lib.mkOption {...})`. Also a real usage: services.pgbackrest.commands.restore.lock-path is set in this same PR's own config.
targets_toml: NEW CAPABILITY GAP CANDIDATE: option_prefix=[services,pgbackrest], watch=[commands] (and also tried watch=['commands.restore.lock-path']) both return 0 discovered_options for the ENTIRE 'commands' branch, at both base and head identically ('unchanged', OptionNotFound both sides). Naming this candidate_capability_gap: genAttrs-computed option set non-discovery -- first instance this round.
